Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You have mentioned available capacity in our calls and emphasised continuity in your proposal—it sounds like steadier business would be especially valuable. We value the relationship and want a simpler, dependable supply arrangement for the complete kit. How could a longer commitment translate into a meaningful bundle discount?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95. Your offer of EUR 5.74 is a 3.5% bundle discount for the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume; we consider EUR 4.88 a fair kit price. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed -1.6% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C2594@2024-10, idx:PPI-C2594@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 is up +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09). Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.60. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.88 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate your proposal to consolidate the kit volume and commit to a 24-month contract. Taking into account the extended term and the verified producer price index development, we are pleased to offer a revised price of EUR 5.46 per unit.

For your reference, our current Angebot is a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Also, please send us the competing offer you mentioned. Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

You have verified the volume data and now ask for a firm commitment; it sounds like dependable demand is the key to a further bundle discount. We want a straightforward complete-kit agreement that gives you planning certainty and rewards consolidation. How can you translate that certainty, alongside the easing in your cited labour costs, into a stronger bundle price?

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. As calculated, your own current prices give EUR 5.95 per kit; our offer reflects a fair bundle discount for a multi-year single-source agreement. That is a contract worth about EUR 188,700 a year. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 5.05 per unit, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the labour cost index data you provided and factored it into our revised offer. While the slight easing in labour costs provides some relief, it only marginally impacts our overall cost structure for this kit. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. In recognition of your firm commitment to a 24-month contract, we are pleased to offer a further reduced price of EUR 5.35 per unit.

For this adjusted Angebot, we can present a price of €5.35 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
